context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 17 tested the Super Search feature. Key findings: (1) Super Search is admin-only - toggle only visible when user.role === 'admin'. (2) When Super Search toggle is ON, competitor brands input appears below it. (3) When Super Search is ON, results table shows 3 extra columns: Grade, Sp. Ratio, Last Aff. (4) Backend enforces admin-only access: /api/channels/enrich with super_search=true returns 403 for non-admin. (5) Competitor brands CRUD endpoints (/api/admin/competitor-brands) are admin-only. (6) Existing cached results (63 channels) don't have Super Search data since they weren't enriched with super_search=true - columns show '-'. All 9 backend tests pass. All frontend UI tests pass.
